enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

ideons.name: Hive Larva
ideons.text: Opening swarm only. Moves one space west, swapping player Constructs into its old space. Does no damage while crossing the grid. On its next command after reaching the left edge, strikes for 18 damage of its element and disappears.

ideons.name: Thought Burrower
ideons.text: Moves left one space, swapping a player Construct into its old space if necessary. Then attacks for 1 damage of its element, even if blocked from moving. At the left edge, instead strikes for 12 damage and disappears. Newly hatched insects wait until the next enemy turn.

ideons.name: Glass Skitter
ideons.text: Moves one space west, northwest or southwest, randomly choosing a legal space and swapping any player Construct into its old space. Then attacks for 1 damage of its element, even if blocked from moving. At the left edge, instead strikes for 9 damage and disappears. Newly hatched insects wait until the next enemy turn.

ideons.name: Thought Burrower
ideons.text: Moves left one space, swapping a player Construct into its old space if necessary. Then attacks for 1 damage of its element, even if blocked from moving. At the left edge, instead strikes for 12 damage and disappears. Newly hatched insects wait until the next enemy turn.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

ideons.name: Glass Skitter
ideons.text: Moves one space west, northwest or southwest, randomly choosing a legal space and swapping any player Construct into its old space. Then attacks for 1 damage of its element, even if blocked from moving. At the left edge, instead strikes for 9 damage and disappears. Newly hatched insects wait until the next enemy turn.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.
